title: Asia sinks 5%, Dalal Street rises: Sensex adds 898 points to 83,919.71 as banks hit records and the rupee crosses 93
short: Asia sinks, India rises: Sensex +898, Nifty 25,800; rupee 92.67
dek: The Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,800.60 and the Sensex 897.96 points to 83,919.71, even as Japan and South Korea fell more than 5% in an AI-stock selloff. Bank stocks led, foreign buying continued, and the rupee gained 65 paise to 92.67.
card: Nifty +286.30 at 25,800.60, Sensex +897.96 at 83,919.71. Bank Nifty +2.49%, Apollo +5.29%. Rupee 92.67, Brent near $90.
